title: Dreams
body:
Last night,
I dreamed of pristine young women,
well-dressed men,
flooding a fictional street of my own creation, lined with bars and restaurants.
There was no room to pass through this torrent of youth, energy, and enthusiasm.
Everyone was naked—
from the neck up.
Beautiful.
It felt like a familiar sight, and yet so distant.

A Freudian would say I took a trip into my innermost thoughts and desires, that I imagined what I cannot live.
That I ardently want what I do not have.

I woke up happy
because I took a walk in the paradise of our era
and came back.
And I have to tell you, freedom is very sweet..
and it resembles fire.

y.f.
